description: The graph illustrates the performance of the CoRe method in reducing the missing step rate across different stages, with the y-axis representing the missing step rate on a linear scale ranging from 0.845 to 0.860, and the x-axis representing the stage number from 0 to 4. Two lines are plotted: a dashed blue line with circular markers and a solid orange line with triangular markers. The dashed blue line starts at a missing step rate of approximately 0.859 at stage 0 and shows a steady decline, reaching about 0.844 at stage 4. The solid orange line begins at a slightly lower rate of approximately 0.859 at stage 0 and also decreases, but at a slower rate, ending at around 0.848 at stage 4. Both lines exhibit a downward trend, indicating improvement in performance as the stage number increases, with the dashed blue line consistently showing a lower missing step rate than the solid orange line across all stages.
